prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Input image is the edit target: Crooked Witch candidate D. Produce ONE full-body transparent PNG with ONLY the visible EYE and its immediate eyelid/eyelash contours changed. User rejected the previous half-lidded result as sleepy and barely awake. Eye must now be visibly OPEN, clearly alert, focused and awake, with a lifted upper eyelid, a rounded almond aperture, visible violet iris and pupil, clean catchlight and natural separation of upper/lower lids. NOT half-closed, NOT drooping upper eyelid, NOT squinting, NOT sleepy, NOT a sly narrow slit. Keep a natural anime eye consistent with her existing face and crisp pixel-art style. Do not enlarge the head or change face shape to accommodate the eye. Preserve D's nose, mouth, chin, hair, head angle and eye placement.
Keep everything else as close to D as possible: exact standing pose, purple/gold costume, hat, embroidery, silver hair, staff, hands, body proportions, position and full-body composition. This is an eye edit, not a character redesign.
Preserve the exact same character identity, body height, head size, shoulder width,
limb proportions, weapon size, camera distance, foot position and lighting as the reference.
Right-facing three-quarter side view, full body and the entire weapon inside the frame,
flat transparent background, no shadow, no text, no border, no scenery.
Centering and framing are positioning choices only: never zoom, scale, stretch or shrink the
character to center it or to fit the full body/weapon. This applies whether the weapon is raised,
lowered or held horizontally. If the weapon makes the silhouette taller or wider, keep the
character and weapon scale fixed and expand the canvas/margins or adjust the framing instead.
If the canonical runtime frame still cannot contain the full weapon at the fixed scale, stop and
ask the user; do not shrink the character or crop the weapon.
Correct near/far layering: the near RIGHT arm and near RIGHT leg are in front of the torso; the far LEFT arm
and far LEFT leg stay behind it. The staff is held by the same RIGHT hand with a believable one-handed grip around
the shaft, at D's unchanged grip point; fingers wrap the shaft, and the hand/weapon do not intersect the torso, head, legs,
hair or clothing. No interpenetration, no merged or extra limbs, no floating parts, and no duplicated weapon.
Do not change the pose. Only change the eye as specified. Variant A: naturally open bright almond eye, relaxed but fully awake. Upper lid is lifted into a gentle arch. Most of the violet iris is clearly visible, with only the very top lightly covered by the lid. Calm attentive gaze to the right. Keep her original character identity, no exaggerated surprise.
